title: Isogeometric multi-patch preconditioner for time-dependent electromagnetic problems
summary: We build upon recent developments in high-order spline-based geometric methods for the three-dimensional initial boundary value problem of Maxwell's equations. Previous schemes were limited to single-patch geometries. To address the computational challenges associated with inverting mass matrices in multi-patch settings, we extend existing techniques for 0-forms mass and stiffness matrices to 1-forms mass matrices.
